The structure of Lu2YCu6 crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with a 9-atom unit cell and three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis gives Cu centers 10 geometric neighbors (4 Cu, 2 Lu, 4 Y), Lu centers 16 neighbors (12 Cu, 4 Y), and Y centers 12 Cu neighbors. The Cu, Lu, and Y coordination polyhedra exhibit corner-, edge-, and face-sharing contacts, including corner-sharing between Cu 10-vertex and Lu 16-vertex polyhedra and corner- and face-sharing between Lu 16-vertex and Y 12-vertex polyhedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component containing all 9 sites.
